PELAV

Data Sources and Attribution

Last updated 14 October 2026

PELAV uses data from the providers below. Each screen that shows their data also shows their credit.

Open-Meteo (weather, sea and forecast data)

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (open-meteo.com), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0).

Open-Meteo marine data uses models including those of Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD).

Changes made by PELAV, as shown on each screen:

  • Home and Marine current conditions: Processed by PELAV: location grid cell, caching and unit/format conversion.
  • Conditions recorded with a catch: Processed by PELAV: recorded when the session started; unit/format conversion.

Derived indicators include the Readiness Score, fishing outlook, best-fishing windows and recommendations, which are PELAV's own calculations, not Open-Meteo's.

Older versions of the App

App versions 1.3.0 and older request Home and Marine current conditions directly from Open-Meteo for the device's location, and show this notice: Processed by PELAV: unit/format conversion and derived indicators.

OpenStreetMap (maps)

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License.

Length-to-Weight calculator

The Length-to-Weight calculator is not available in this version of the App. In App versions 1.3.0 and older, its coefficients are from Harrison, T.D. (2001), "Length-weight relationships of fishes from South African estuaries", Journal of Applied Ichthyology, 17(1), 46–48.

PELAV

The fishing-spot directory, species knowledge base, Readiness Score and recommendations are maintained or calculated by PELAV.
